claims.proposition: For the closed canonical value grammar, equal schema and field values produce equal bytes; floats, missing required fields, duplicate schema_version, and unknown fields are rejected.
Submission and activation require verified exact-byte retrieval from operational, recovery, and archive layers; any missing or failed layer blocks both effects.
A successful grant preserves A, adds B exactly once, advances one revision and consumes replay; every rejected grant preserves the pre-state.
Submitted and confirmed observations cannot activate delivery; only matching finalized state with three-layer readiness can activate it.
Authorized reissue changes only B's envelope plus the permitted revision and request state; every rejected reissue preserves the old envelope and protected state.
Network and storage infrastructure costs remain distinct observations while knowledge consideration is exactly zero and absent from on-chain protocol state.
Signing keys, HPKE private keys, and content keys are non-collapsing roles; none may enter public state, and an envelope can be opened only through its recipient's custody binding.
